name: Iweriadd

attributes.attribute: a Welsh heroine named in some sources as the mother of Bran the Blessed and Manawydan
given in other texts as the mother of Bran the Blessed and Manawydan, and as the mother of Branwen

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Iweriadd is a Welsh heroine. Some sources name Iweriadd as the mother of the heroes Bran the Blessed and Manawydan. Other texts name their mother as Penarddun. Penarddun also appears as the mother of Branwen, their sister.

okr.objective: Document Iweriadd as a Welsh heroine.
key_results: Record the alternate mothers named for Bran the Blessed and Manawydan.
Note Penarddun as the mother of Branwen.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Iweriadd entry.
